en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cobblestone street in a European town. Tall narrow townhouses line both sides, with simple stucco facades and shutterless windows. In the background stands a prominent church tower with a clock face and a slender spire topped by a weather vane. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children and a woman pushing a handcart, walk along the street. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.
